newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil government loses vote on reform amendment.
newsitem.headline: Brazil government loses vote on reform amendment.

text.p: The Brazilian government on Tuesday failed to muster enough votes in the Chamber of Deputies to kill an opposition amendment to its civil service reform bill, an official said.
The amendment strikes down an article of the bill that would have allowed state and municipal governments to set pay ceilings below a 10,800 real ($10,188) monthly cap.
The government managed to gather 301 votes against the amendment, seven less than the three-fifths majority of 308 votes needed to defeat it, a congressional official said.
